I added the CSS for `.notification-results` at the end of `app/assets/stylesheets/custom/tables.scss`. I haven't run it in a browser, and I didn't write the feature spec or run any specs, including `spec/lib/notifier_spec.rb`.

The rule sets `table-layout: fixed` and `width: 100%` on the table, and `overflow-wrap: anywhere` on its `th` and `td` cells. The "Para" and "Assunto" columns get 25% each, so "Corpo" takes the remaining 50%. Without explicit widths, the fixed layout would split the three columns equally.

I didn't confirm that `tables.scss` is actually pulled into the stylesheet bundle. The only `require` line in `application.*` is `require_self`, so check that it gets included.

`Notifier`, the view and the existing specs are unchanged. `.notification-results` appears only in `simulate.html.erb` under `app`, so no other view is affected.
